params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Miss Fortune}} {{tip|basic attacks}} apply a mark that expires when attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Miss Fortune's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to apply a mark that expires upon attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 to 100 for 6|1;4;7 to 13|formula=50% + 10% every 3 levels up to 7, then + 10% every 2 levels up to 13}} AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, halved to {{as|{{pp|key=%|50/2 to 100/2 for 6|1;4;7 to 13|formula=25% + 5% every 3 levels up to 7, then + 5% every 2 levels up to 13}} AD}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}.
params.notes:
* With {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}, ''Love Tap'' only applies to the primary target.
* The bonus damage applies {{sti|life steal|link=true}}.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against [[buildings]]<!--buildings?-->.

blurb.plain: Innate: Miss Fortune basic attacks apply a mark that expires when attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals bonus physical damage.

description.plain: Innate: Miss Fortune's basic attacks are empowered to apply a mark that expires upon attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals 50% – 100% (based on level) AD bonus physical damage, halved to 25% – 50% (based on level) AD against minions.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Miss Fortune}} fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, which then bounces to hit another enemy behind them. This applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to both enemies hit.
params.blurb2: ''Double Up's'' bounce can {{tip|critically strike}}, and does so if ''Double Up'' kills the primary target.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and bounces to hit another enemy behind them, applying {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the primary target and {{tip|on-hit}} effects to both enemies hit.
params.description2: ''Double Up's'' bounce can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}If ''Double Up'' kills the primary target, the bounce will {{tip|critically strike}}.
params.description3: ''The bounce prioritizes units directly behind the primary target. A target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by the bounce.''
params.target range: {{tt|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} 550 (+ 100% '''bonus''' {{sti|attack range}})|Always equal to Miss Fortune's attack range}}
params.notes:
* ''Double Up'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} to both targets, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} can be used by either target. If it is on the primary target, the spell shield will not prevent the shot from bouncing. 
* Neutral units count as valid targets to bounce.
* The bounce follows a priority order on targets behind in a certain angle:
*# 500 units in 20º.
*# 500 units in 40º.
*# 500 units in 110º.
*# {{tt|150 units|Estimated}} in 160º.
* ''Double Up's'' cast range adjusts based on '''Miss Fortune's''' {{sti|attack range}}, which can be increased by items such as {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}.
* The damage of a {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}} shot is {{ap|20*1.5 to 120*1.5}} {{as|(+ 150% AD)}} {{as|(+ 52.5% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased to {{ap|20*1.65 to 120*1.65}} {{as|(+ 165% AD)}} {{as|(+ 57.75% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} by {{iis|Infinity Edge}} bonus critical damage.
* If there is no secondary target, the shot will not bounce and the dud will instead fall to the ground.
** The dud lands on the ground 176 units behind the primary target and has a missile speed of 400 on its way there.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}

blurb.plain: Active: Miss Fortune fires a shot at the target enemy that deals physical damage, which then bounces to hit another enemy behind them. This applies on-hit effects to both enemies hit.

blurb2.plain: Double Up's bounce can critically strike, and does so if Double Up kills the primary target.

description.plain: Active: Miss Fortune fires a shot at the target enemy that deals physical damage and bounces to hit another enemy behind them, applying on-attack effects to the primary target and on-hit effects to both enemies hit.

description2.plain: Double Up's bounce can critically strike for (150% + Infinity Edge 20%) damage. If Double Up kills the primary target, the bounce will critically strike.

description3.plain: The bounce prioritizes units directly behind the primary target. A target does not have to be visible to be hit by the bounce.

blurb3.plain: Active: Miss Fortune gains bonus attack speed for a few seconds.

description.plain: Active: Miss Fortune casts a storm of bullets at the target location for 2 seconds, granting sight of the area, dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies within, and slowing them by 40% (+ 6% per 100 AP).

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Miss Fortune}} {{tip|channel|channels}} for a short time, firing several waves of bullets in the target direction that deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Each wave can {{tip|critically strike}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Miss Fortune''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, firing a number of waves of bullets in the target direction. Each wave is in a spread of 6 projectiles that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
params.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage per Wave|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 60% AD)}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Waves|{{ap|14 to 18}}|Maximum Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*14 to 40*18}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*14 to 60*18}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*14 to 25*18}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Wave Interval Time|{{ap|2.85/(14 to 18)|round=4}} seconds}}
params.description2: Each of the waves can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|145|45}}|critical damage}} damage.
params.angle: {{tt|30{{degree}}|The effective angle is wider based the width of the missile streams + enemy size}}
params.notes:
* The damage dealt by each wave of ''Bullet Time'' is calculated when the wave reaches the target.
* '''Miss Fortune''' {{tip|sight|reveals}} a 200-radius area around herself for {{fd|2.0}} seconds to the enemy team if she fires from an unseen location and there is one of their units within the target cone of {{pending for test}} 1400 units radius and 17{{degree}} cone (toward either side from her facing direction), and repeatedly as she fires waves while enemies are in a cone of {{pending for test}} 1500 units radius and 23{{degree}} cone (toward either side from her facing direction) in front of her.
* Targets cannot be damaged by more than one projectile per wave.
* The bullet streams that each fire 1 projectile per wave are spead by 6{{degree}} between one another, aiming towards the angles +-3/9/15{{degree}} from '''Miss Fortune's''' facing direction.
* ''Bullet Time'' picks 6 locations on the ground 500 units from '''Miss Fortune''' (with the aforementioned angles) and fires a bullet stream towards each.
** If '''Miss Fortune''' is moved to a new location, these locations '''will''' update (since patch [[V13.3]]); the cone will fire towards her new facing direction.
* The unusually short [[cast time]] of ''Bullet Time'' will result in an effective cast time of {{rutngt|0.001}}, as the server must wait until the next game tick for the channel time to start.
** '''Miss Fortune''' is allowed to cast {{si|Flash}} during this ''cast time''. As {{si|Flash}} changes the user's facing direction, this will cause ''Bullet Time'' to fire in the new facing direction.
*** Casting {{si|Flash}} before the cast time will not affect the cast direction (''Bullet Time'' will correctly fire towards the targeted location on the ground). 
* ''Bullet Time'' fires the first wave at {{rutngt|0.05}}, and the last at {{rutngt|2.9}}. Times between waves are equally spread between these values.
** '''Miss Fortune''' may cancel the last ~{{fd|0.1}} seconds of channel time at no loss of effect.

blurb.plain: Active: Miss Fortune channels for a short time, firing several waves of bullets in the target direction that deal physical damage to enemies hit. Each wave can critically strike.

description.plain: Active: Miss Fortune channels for up to 3 seconds, firing a number of waves of bullets in the target direction. Each wave is in a spread of 6 projectiles that deals physical damage to enemies hit.

description2.plain: Each of the waves can critically strike for (145% + Infinity Edge 18%) damage.
